texts.preamble: Yerra Lakshmi Narayana vs State Of Andhra Pradesh on 31 January, 2020 Author: J. Uma Devi Bench: J.Uma Devi The Hon'Ble Ms.JUSTICE J.Uma Devi Criminal Petition No.558 Of 2020 Order:
texts.facts: This criminal petition is filed by the petitioner/ accused, seeking to quash the proceedings in P.R.C.No.116 of 2019 on the file of the Court of II Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Nellore District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 272, 273 and 328 of I.P.C and Section 58 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006. The case on hand has also been filed questioning the proceedings in P.R.C.No.116 of 2019 on the file of the Court of II Additional Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Nellore District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 272, 273 and 328 of I.P.C and Section 58 of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.
